pages.text: Spatial Storage Cells are used to $(l:ae2_mechanics/spatial_io)store physical volumes of space$(/l). They are used in a $(l:items_blocks_machines/spatial_io_port)Spatial IO Port$(/l).$(br2)Unlike $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_cells)Storage Cells$(/l), spatial cells cannot be reformatted.$(br2)Again, $(bold)YOU CANNOT RESET, REFORMAT, OR RESIZE A SPATIAL CELL AFTER IT HAS BEEN USED.$() Make a new cell if you want to use different dimensions.

pages.text: Spatial Components are the core of spatial storage cells. Each tier increases the dimensions of the volume that can be stored by factor of 8.
